iou_method: ray sampling: 1000 random axis-parallel lines per axis (X, Y, Z), exact in/out intervals per line
volume_method: BRepGProp volume integration with eps 1e-9 (the default integration is off by up to 0.03 mm3 here)
exact_volume_note: analytic: blank (cylinder + 45 deg chamfered end wall) - bore - groove, the groove being screw-symmetric over the whole 25 mm wall: (25 / 3.5) * 2 pi * integral of r * width(r) dr over the groove section outside the bore. Candidate +0.0014 mm3, reference +0.0141 mm3: the remaining difference is the reference's own sweep approximation

point_iou_classifier.method: BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier, uniform points in the union box (seeds 11, 12)

thread_fit.method: cap placed at auger z = 250 (inner end face on the tube end), turned about Z; overlap volume from 1500 random lines along X through z = 222..252

vs_parts_auger_fs_thread.note: local fsgen build of a copy of parts/auger.fs reduced to tube + thread; lines up to z = 249.95 because the local build leaves the thread untrimmed above the tube end

thread_fit.conclusion: mates with no overlap when turned 180 deg about Z (frames.py CAP_TURN_DEG), as the reference does; unturned it overlaps (frames.py notes 546 mm3)

local_build: fsgen 0.2.0 studio build (stock local builder): 1 solid, 11 features, 0 Onshape calls
